title: Websites for individuals
summary: A site for you and your practice or private work, with search and marketing set up around it.
metaDescription: Sites for a person and their practice or private work, with SEO and digital marketing. A clear site, a way to reach you, and marketing built around it.

sections.heading: Who this is for
paragraphs: This work is for a person and the practice or private work they run online. A doctor’s practice is one example: patients need to understand who you are, what you offer, and how to get in touch.
The same pattern fits consultants, therapists, coaches, and others who work under their own name.

sections.heading: What you get
paragraphs: A site that explains who you are and what you do in plain language.
A clear way for people to reach you—phone, email, or message—without hunting through a generic template.
Search and marketing set up around that site: SEO and digital marketing as services, so people who need your work can find you.

sections.heading: How we work
paragraphs: We learn how you work and who you serve, then structure the site and the marketing around that. You review the proposal before build starts; we deliver a site you can maintain with your team or with us.

title: Enterprise software
summary: Software built for how your company runs, so your team keeps using it after we leave.
metaDescription: Software for a company to improve how it runs operations. We understand the operation, build around it, and leave your team with a system they use.

sections.heading: What this is
paragraphs: Enterprise software here means systems built for your company—not a generic product with your logo on it. The goal is to improve how work moves through your operation: fewer manual handoffs, clearer status, and tools that match how your team already thinks.

sections.heading: The engagement
paragraphs: We start by understanding how the operation works today: where data lives, who decides what, and what breaks under load.
We design and build software around that reality, in steps you can review.
We leave your team with a system they use day to day, with documentation and handover so you are not dependent on a black box.

sections.heading: When it fits
paragraphs: This fits when spreadsheets and ad hoc tools are slowing you down, when a new process needs software behind it, or when an older system no longer matches how the business runs. We name no product; the work is shaped to your operation.
